description: FastAPI application with endpoints for handling file uploads and serving a basic HTML form.

methods.name: create_files( files: list[bytes] = File(description="Multiple files as bytes"), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /files/ to accept multiple files as bytes and returns their sizes.

methods.name: create_upload_files( files: list[UploadFile] = File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile"), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /uploadfiles/ to accept multiple UploadFile objects and returns their filenames.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to / and returns an HTML page with forms for uploading files.

ctags.name: create_files
ctags.signature: ( files: list[bytes] = File(description="Multiple files as bytes"), )

ctags.name: create_upload_files
ctags.signature: ( files: list[UploadFile] = File(description="Multiple files as UploadFile"), )
